classify.reason: A self-hosted engine and server for running large MoE LLMs on personal GPUs with an OpenAI-compatible API and quantization tools.

description: Project Maya - run GLM-5.3-Flash (321B MoE), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (748B MoE) and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (428B MoE) privately on your own GPU(s), from one card to 16, NVIDIA or AMD, Linux or Windows. Engine, server, dashboard, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, quant tools.
